title: 382. Peeking Iterator

examples.explanation: next gives 1, peek previews 2, next gives 2, next gives 3, then nothing remains (0).
One value present (1), next returns it, then empty (0).
Repeated peeks return 1 without advancing; next returns 1; one value remains.

hints: Adaptation: instead of a PeekingIterator class, implement runPeek(nums, operations) simulating the calls.
Keep an index: next returns nums[i++], peek returns nums[i], hasNext returns 1/0.
Cache nothing extra; peek never advances.
